sp.help.title: Why only 30 seconds? Step-by-step fix
sp.help.1: Log in to Spotify at open.spotify.com in this same browser (the desktop Spotify app doesn't count). Then reload this page with Ctrl+F5.
sp.help.2: The player is served from Spotify's site, so the browser treats its login as a third-party cookie; if those are blocked, the login never reaches the player. Private/incognito windows never work.
sp.help.3: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Third-party cookies → "Sites allowed to use third-party cookies" → Add: [*.]cesarecarr.github.io. (Or allow it for this site via the eye icon in the address bar.)
sp.help.4: Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions → Manage cookies → add [*.]spotify.com to "Allow"; if Tracking prevention is "Strict", add this site to Exceptions. Firefox: shield icon in the address bar → turn off Tracking Protection for this site. Brave: lion icon → Shields down for this site.
sp.help.5: Safari / iPhone: strict cookie rules mean it usually plays previews only. On phones, YouTube is recommended.
sp.help.6: Full tracks are certain with Spotify Premium; Spotify doesn't guarantee them on free accounts. If nothing helps, choose "Switch to YouTube automatically" above.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Who is responsible

Prog Rock Network Atlas is a private, non-commercial project. Responsible for data processing: {who}. Contact: {email}

Using the atlas without an account

No account is needed. Your language, platform choice and lists are stored only in your browser (local storage) and never reach us. There is no tracking, no analytics and no advertising.

Account (optional)

If you sign in with Google, the following is stored via Google Firebase (Google Ireland Ltd.):

  • from your Google account: user ID, name, email address, profile picture link, sign-in times;
  • your lists: names, tracks and notes.

Purpose: to keep your lists and sync them between your devices. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (providing the service you requested). Lists are stored in the EU; Google may also process data outside the EU (e.g. in the USA) under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses. Your data is not shared with anyone else and not used for any other purpose.

Deletion

Under Settings → Account → "Delete account and data" you can delete your account and all lists immediately and completely.

Embedded players and hosting

Music is played through embedded players from Spotify or YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com). They load only when you start playback; from then on the respective provider's privacy policy applies, and they may set their own cookies. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc.), which processes technical access data such as IP addresses to deliver the site.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability (Settings → Backup) and objection. You can lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (dsb.gv.at).
sp.prev.mob: On phones, Spotify only plays 30-second previews in embedded players. This track has no YouTube version; open it in the Spotify app to hear it in full.
sp.mob.set: On phones and tablets, Spotify only allows 30-second previews in players embedded on other websites, whatever your browser settings. So the player bar plays full tracks from YouTube here; the "Open in Spotify app" button above the player opens the current track in the Spotify app. On a computer, full tracks play directly from Spotify.
